tasks.short: Analyse loan markets and build referral networks to find prospects.

steps.what: Collect local market indicators, existing enquiry patterns and referral-source activity
Interpret market changes and decide which people or firms are credible referral partners
Record partner context, agreed next contact and source of each referral
Review whether a referral source is useful and appropriate to continue

loop.output: source-level trend summary with missing context marked
loop.check: the officer checks that low volume is not mistaken for poor quality and reads the underlying referrals
loop.stop: stop on insufficient history or a concern about referral conduct; investigate manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Counts can be grouped, but relationship quality and suitability of a partner require context.

tasks.design: A {CRM} view groups enquiry and referral outcomes with market signals, while a {WORKFLOW} records follow-up actions. The loan officer decides which relationships to build and reviews whether the network serves suitable prospects.
tasks.previous_blocker: Market notes, partner conversations and referral outcomes sit in separate files and personal memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A dashboard can group known signals and a CRM can retain partner context and referral source.
tasks.still_hard: Trust, local knowledge and whether a referral relationship is appropriate depend on human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can build a reciprocal relationship and recognise when a source creates poor-fit enquiries.

ambition.what: Give trusted referral partners a clear route to introduce a prospect with the prospect's permission.

tasks.altitude: The officer improves referral quality and market hypotheses rather than updating contact lists.

reach.task: Assess a referral source and agree a joint prospecting action
reach.learn: Separate observed conversion data from relationship judgement.

evidence.claim: A dashboard and records workflow can group existing activity, while relationship selection remains model knowledge judgement.

assumptions: The boundary starts with available market and referral data and ends with a reviewed referral-network action, not an unsolicited marketing send.
The network contract contains source ID, market signal date, partner context, referral permission, prospect status, next contact and outcome; the officer records relationship context.
A missing referral permission blocks storing or acting on prospect details.
Native CRM account, activity and source reporting features are tested before custom code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for source taxonomy and dashboard-rule maintenance.
unknowns: Which market indicators are reliable at the officer's local level.
What permission and referral agreements apply to each partner type.
research_questions: Which referral sources produce complete applications?
Which market signals precede a change in loan enquiry mix?

incremental.description: Maintain source taxonomy and market dashboard rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Relationship development remains most of the task; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Validate principal, rate, term, repayment frequency, start date and fee inputs
Calculate instalments, interest, principal balance and final payment for each due date
Check rounding, first and final payment, rate treatment and any non-standard repayment condition

loop.output: exception list for dates, rate changes, rounding and final balance
loop.check: the officer independently checks exceptions and that the balance reaches zero under approved terms
loop.stop: stop on a non-standard condition, mismatch or unknown rate treatment; correct the inputs or obtain a calculation review
loop.why_not_simpler: The arithmetic is deterministic, but contract terms can contain a non-standard condition that needs interpretation.

steps.what: Attach the checked schedule to the application or customer record

tasks.design: The {CRM} supplies versioned approved terms to a deterministic schedule calculator, which returns the schedule and trace. A loan officer checks non-standard terms and exceptions before the {DOCS} record is updated.
tasks.previous_blocker: A payment schedule is re-entered into a spreadsheet and checked by reading cells beside the loan terms.
tasks.enabler_now: Principal, rate, term and due-date arithmetic are deterministic and can be versioned with their inputs.
tasks.still_hard: The organisation must define treatment of unusual contract terms, rate changes and rounding.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can recognise that a schedule is mathematically sound but inconsistent with the customer's approved arrangement.

ambition.what: Show an applicant a checked payment schedule with the exact terms and version used to calculate it.

tasks.altitude: The officer monitors calculation exceptions and improves product-rule definitions rather than building schedules cell by cell.

reach.task: Test a repayment scenario against approved loan terms
reach.learn: Read a calculation trace and identify a non-standard assumption.

evidence.claim: The digest identifies payment schedules as rules and arithmetic suited to plain code and configuration.

assumptions: The boundary starts with approved schedule inputs and ends with a checked schedule stored on the case, not a loan approval.
The input contract contains principal, rate type, rate, term, frequency, first due date, fee treatment, rounding rule and contract version; the approved case provides the values.
A missing or non-standard rule produces an exception instead of a calculated schedule.
Native loan-system schedule configuration is tested before custom calculation code.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for product-rule and exception maintenance.
unknowns: Which rate and fee conventions apply to each loan product.
Whether the existing loan system already provides a traceable calculation engine.
research_questions: What share of payment schedules contain non-standard terms?
Which input errors cause schedule rework today?

already_counted.description: Officer exception check of the calculated schedule

incremental.description: Maintain product calculation rules and review exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes frequent non-standard terms need a human exception check; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review workload, queue age, quality signals and availability across loan personnel
Allocate work, coach an officer and decide how to handle quality or capacity concerns
Record agreed actions, due dates and service-risk follow-ups

tasks.design: A {BI} operating view assembles queue and quality facts from the {CRM}; a {WORKFLOW} records agreed actions. The supervisor remains responsible for allocation, coaching, performance judgement and difficult people decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervisors compile a team picture from separate queues and then re-enter agreements as reminders.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing work and quality data can be surfaced together with action tracking.
tasks.still_hard: Performance context, wellbeing, development and fair workload decisions require a manager who knows the people involved.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor can coach, resolve conflict and balance urgent service needs with sustainable development.

ambition.what: Review the daily queue with early warning of cases at risk of missing service commitments.

tasks.altitude: The supervisor improves team operating rules instead of assembling status updates.

reach.task: Run a service-risk review across a team queue
reach.learn: Interpret queue measures without treating them as a substitute for individual context.

evidence.claim: A dashboard and workflow can prepare operational facts and action tracking; people management remains model knowledge judgement.

assumptions: The boundary starts with operational team data and ends with a manager's recorded allocation or coaching action.
The team contract contains case ID, owner, queue age, service state, quality signal, availability, action owner and due date; operational systems provide the measures.
Sensitive people information is visible only to authorised managers and is not used to automate a performance decision.
Native work-queue reporting and action tracking are tested before a custom dashboard.
One hour per 100 focal-role baseline hours is allowed for metric definitions and dashboard access review.
unknowns: Which measures are appropriate for coaching versus formal performance management.
Whether queue and quality data have sufficient timeliness and ownership.
research_questions: Which signals predict a case needing supervisor help?
How much supervisor time is currently spent compiling team status?

already_counted.description: Supervisor judgement in allocation and coaching

incremental.description: Maintain metric definitions and dashboard access

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Coaching and allocation remain the main work; one upkeep hour per 100 baseline hours is deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare delinquency reports and forward irreconcilable accounts for collection action.

steps.what: Select accounts past due and calculate arrears, payment history and contact status
Check hardship markers, disputes, recent payments and exceptions before action

loop.input: account events, correspondence and exception rules
loop.output: action-eligible status with supporting reasons and exception flags
loop.check: the officer checks hardship, dispute and recent-payment flags against the original case records
loop.stop: stop on a dispute, vulnerability marker, payment arrangement or missing history; route to a human review
loop.why_not_simpler: The overdue rule is fixed, but an appropriate action depends on the customer's current circumstances.

steps.what: Prepare the correct delinquency report or collection referral package from approved templates
Review the report, communicate the appropriate next action or forward an irreconcilable account

tasks.design: A {CRM} delinquency view computes arrears and identifies exception markers, then a {WORKFLOW} prepares source-linked notices or referral packs. A loan officer checks the customer situation and remains responsible for an external communication or collector handover.
tasks.previous_blocker: Arrears are selected, checked, drafted and logged through separate reports, mail and case screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Arrears and payment rules can be applied across records and approved templates can assemble the factual report.
tasks.still_hard: A dispute, hardship or payment arrangement changes the appropriate action and must be handled carefully.
tasks.human_edge: The officer can distinguish a clerical delay from a customer in difficulty and choose a proportionate next step.

ambition.what: Give customers with a missed payment a timely, clear report before an account becomes irreconcilable.

tasks.altitude: The officer reviews exception patterns and improves collection triggers instead of assembling routine reports.

reach.task: Assess an exception before external collection action
reach.learn: Read arrears evidence alongside hardship and dispute context.

evidence.claim: The digest describes rules over every record with exceptions routed to a person for financial checks.

assumptions: The boundary starts with an account becoming overdue and ends with a reviewed report, customer communication or collector referral.

The action contract contains account ID, overdue amount, due date, payment history, dispute state, hardship marker, arrangement state, template version, action and evidence links; the account system supplies the factual fields.
A dispute, vulnerability marker or payment arrangement blocks automated external communication.
Native arrears, template and collection-routing configuration is tested before custom code.
Two hours per 100 focal-role baseline hours are allowed for template, exception-rule and collection-route maintenance.
unknowns: Which staff may send a delinquency notice or refer an account to a collector.
What hardship, dispute and regulatory processes apply to the lender's accounts.
research_questions: What share of overdue accounts have a payment arrangement or dispute?
Which report fields cause a collector referral to be returned?

incremental.description: Maintain notice templates, exception rules and collector routes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes many accounts need a customer-specific review before action; two upkeep hours per 100 baseline hours are deducted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Run a daily exception review across incomplete applications, credit evidence and authority routes.
reach: personal financial advisor: recognise when an applicant needs broader budgeting or debt advice
role.ambitious_version: Give more applicants a complete, understandable path from enquiry to an accountable lending decision.
